owner_task_reference: Additional OWNER requirements: prohibit Qwen/Voyage vector overlap; stop Eros before backup and cleanup; reset is backup-and-restore-gated and idempotent; verify native Voyage memory before stopping Ollama; remove temporary release-workflow cleanup logic after successful transition; do not run Dialogue Lab.

additional_safety_contract.quiescence: Before backup and vector cleanup, stop the exact verified Eros engine with stock Kamal; keep it stopped until the native Voyage Eros image is running and its new-memory verification passes.
additional_safety_contract.cleanup: Use the parent authorization's exact target tables, row counts and database protections. Store a durable pre-delete intent and completion receipt. On repeat for the same exact candidate/image, verify the cleared state and never issue the DELETE a second time.
additional_safety_contract.provider_exclusivity: The active Eros model config selects native voyage-4-lite at 512 dimensions, and the Core API has no Ollama network membership or active Ollama embedding URL. Do not start Qwen while Voyage memory is active.
additional_safety_contract.retirement: Only after the new-memory write/recall verification succeeds may the pinned Ollama container be stopped. Preserve its image and model volume for separately gated recovery.
additional_safety_contract.temporary_workflow_logic: After this exact transition has successfully completed, remove the one-time vector-reset and Voyage-cutover gate from the normal release workflow in a follow-up local change and use the same protected release path to publish that cleanup. The cleanup must not repeat data deletion or trigger an unrelated component migration.
additional_safety_contract.scope_exclusion: Do not run full Dialogue Lab, add services/workers/workflows, access real-user data, or change unrelated product paths.
